title: First-pass aggregation signature and elicitation play
creator: Maya Chen
description: Objective: Create a lightweight, repeatable 'signature' and elicitation play used by Sales and CS to collect standardized information for enterprise feature requests. The signature payload is a minimal structured summary that enables automatic aggregation, initial prioritization scoring, and a deterministic handoff to PM/ENG. This ticket covers the play (templated intake + scoring heuristics + sample training materials for CS) and a first-pass prototype of the scoring rules and output summary.
acceptance_criteria: A templated intake form (Google Form + short script) with 8 canonical fields: business objective, target user persona, key success metric, indicative monthly usage, data sensitivity level, regulatory constraints, preferred timeline, and budget signal.
A one-page 'signature' JSON schema example and mapping doc (Confluence) that Sales/CS can paste into intake entries.
A deterministic initial-feasibility score computed from the 8 fields with clear cutoffs (low/medium/high feasibility) and an economic impact score (S/M/L) documented.
Automated aggregation pipeline spec that groups similar signatures by objective + persona + metric and emits weekly digest CSV for PM review.
Pilot run with 3 CS reps and 2 AE reps capturing at least 20 sample requests within 2 weeks and evidence of improved triage speed (median first-pass triage time down >= 40%).
out_of_scope: Full UI work in Console for long-term intake (this ticket is focused on template + pipeline + docs).
Implementation of billing/contract templates or legal review flows.
Backend autoscaling or dedicated capacity purchasing mechanics (only intake metadata captured).
proposed_solution: Ship a lightweight package: (1) a 1-page intake template (Google Form + short parse script that emits the signature JSON), (2) Confluence 'signature schema' page with examples and quick scoring rubric, (3) a small Google Apps Script that compiles submissions into a weekly digest CSV and tags near-duplicate entries, and (4) a playbook snippet for CS to use during discovery calls. Scoring heuristics will be rule-based for the pilot (e.g., budget signal >= 'committed' -> econ impact = Large; usage >= 100k tokens/month -> feasibility lower due to capacity needs). If pilot data shows >50% ambiguous results, iterate to add clarifying fields or short follow-up questions.
risks_and_mitigation: Sales adoption risk: keep form < 3 minutes to fill and provide ready-made copy for CS to paste into case notes.
Ambiguous inputs: include closed choices for key fields and an optional free-text for nuance.
False negatives on feasibility: conservative scoring for initial routing (route 'ambiguous' to PM triage queue rather than auto-reject).
metrics: Primary: median first-pass triage time (baseline measured from pilot)
Secondary: percent of requests auto-classified as high feasibility, percent of signatures requiring follow-up clarifying questions
Operational: weekly digest rows / duplicates flagged
